payload.recallText: It's the last day of school and the class is learning about the Oregon trail. I am a teacher and I talk with lost of ums. I write out stories and my kids acts out the Oregon trail. One day we are about to hit the Rockies and I decide to switch things up a bit and make things interesting. One student, Katie Chubbuck who has a rough voice comes to the front of the class. I am wearing a bonnet in the spirit of the game. She rolls the dice and she's trapped under the wagon. She rolls again and she has an infection in her legs. She rolls again and the infection gets worse. I didn't think it would get this far so I didn't know what to do. Years later I am walking on the street and Katie who is now stretched sees me and says "hey do you remember the day that I almost died Oregon Trail". And I said "yes, Katie, I do remember that day.
